hints.title: Frequency Counting
hints.text: Count how many times each distinct integer appears in the input collection.

hints.title: Greedy Elimination
hints.text: To minimize the count of distinct values remaining, remove elements with the smallest frequencies first.

hints.title: Ascending Frequency Order
hints.text: Sort frequencies ascending. Deduct each frequency from k as long as k is greater than or equal to the frequency, decrementing the unique count.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Arbitrary removal without frequency ordering leaves more unique numbers alive.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting frequencies takes O(N) and sorting unique counts takes O(U log U) <= O(N log N).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate identifies greedy choice property: eliminating lowest frequency numbers frees up unique values fastest.
complexity.notes: Can also be solved in O(N) using bucket counting.

solutions.approach: Count frequencies and greedily remove smallest counts first
